project_type: React 19 + Vite SPA frontend (port 5173) with Django 5 REST API backend (port 8000)
build_system: Vite 8 (frontend), Django manage.py (backend). Frontend: npm run dev (starts Vite dev server on port 5173). No monorepo tooling — frontend and backend are separate directories.
test_framework: None configured. No Jest, Vitest, or pytest test files found. Verification is manual via browser after `npm run dev`.
test_command: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && npm run dev   (then inspect in browser for visual/functional correctness)
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run dev` from frontend directory. 2) Open http://localhost:5173 in browser. 3) Toggle between Light and Dark mode using the sun/moon button in navbar. 4) Check that backgrounds are blue-tinted (never white or earthy-peach). 5) Navigate to /upload, /dashboard, /digital-twin, /diet, /profile. 6) Verify Scanner page has wider right column. 7) Verify Health Twin shows only 2D anatomy SVG (no 3D/BioDigital buttons). 8) Check browser console for no errors.
environment_constraints: Backend .env has GOOGLE_API_KEY and DEFAULT_LLM_MODEL keys (no OPENAI_API_KEY present). Backend runs on port 8000. Frontend proxies to 8000 via Vite config. Do NOT restart the backend unless changing Python code. Windows PowerShell environment.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Work directly in the existing repo. Preserve all working functionality, authentication, routes, database relationships, and backend integrations.
key_patterns: 1) All theme variables live in :root/[data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light'] blocks at the top of frontend/src/index.css. 2) The ThemeProvider in frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.jsx sets data-theme attribute on document.documentElement. 3) CSS variable names --bg-*, --text-*, --accent-*, --border-color, --card-*, --form-surface, --input-surface drive all component colors. 4) Components use Bootstrap-like utility classes (col-lg-*, d-flex, etc.) defined in index.css — not imported from Bootstrap. 5) Lucide React icons throughout. 6) Framer Motion for page transitions. 7) SidebarContext for injecting sidebar content per-page. 8) JWT auth via localStorage medfusion_token.
directory_structure: medfusion-ai/frontend/src/: pages/ (Dashboard.jsx, Upload.jsx, GuestUpload.jsx, Landing.jsx, Auth.jsx, DietPlanner.jsx, NearbyMap.jsx, Profile.jsx, DigitalTwin.jsx, EmergencyCard.jsx), pages/dashboard/ (PatientDashboard.jsx, DoctorDashboard.jsx, GuestDashboard.jsx), pages/digital-twin/ (AnatomyDiagram.jsx, OrganInfoPanel.jsx, HealthTimeline.jsx, MedicationSafetyPanel.jsx, HealthChangeExplorer.jsx, OrganViewer3D.jsx, BioDigitalViewer.jsx), pages/profile/ (ProfileIdentity.jsx, MedicalVault.jsx, RiskAssessments.jsx, PillBox.jsx), components/ (AIChatbot.jsx, InteractiveMap.jsx, VoiceExplainer.jsx), context/ (ThemeContext.jsx, SidebarContext.jsx, useTheme.js), services/ (api.js, utils.js). medfusion-ai/backend/: medical/ (views.py, models.py, urls.py, diet_views.py, garden_views.py, services/)
